messages:
taylor: Heads-up: proposal to merge route_metrics_v2 + route_metrics_v3 into metrics_unified to simplify console queries. plan: dual-write for 2w, backfill, then canary reads.

anya: sounds good. what's storage/backfill impact?

phil: We'll need composite indexes (route_id, ts, metric_kind) and keep tenant_id as materialized column to avoid jsonb index explosion. preserve enum versions.

jamal: Prefer read-adapter (view + small query-service translator) over changing all dashboard SQL. lower blast radius.

irene: Agree. We'll gate with a console feature flag for canary routes. QA will run against the shim.

phil: Migration outline:
1) create metrics_unified (schema draft below)
2) turn on dual-write in ingest
3) nightly backfill for last 6 months (sharded by route_id)
4) enable read-adapter for 5% canary
5) monitor p99 & cost 48h -> full cutover

phil: schema draft: CREATE TABLE metrics_unified (route_id uuid NOT NULL, ts timestamptz NOT NULL, metric_kind text NOT NULL, value double precision, attrs jsonb, tenant_id uuid, region text, source_version int NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (route_id, ts, metric_kind, source_version)); CREATE INDEX ON metrics_unified (route_id, ts DESC); CREATE INDEX ON metrics_unified (tenant_id);

anya: add contract doc mapping source_version (v2->1, v3->2, unified->3) and update alerts for p99 regressions.

taylor: Ops checklist: create table + indexes, flip dual-write, deploy read-adapter behind flag, run backfill (monitor bloat/IO), canary 5% -> observe -> full. rollback: revert flag + stop reads, keep dual-write.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: query-service/read-adapter -> 2026-03-25T06:00:00Z (CI #4521).

jamal: I'll own backfill runner and throttles. irene owns console flag and QA. phil will run EXPLAIN on heavy dashboards. taylor to draft migration playbook today.
